  ('public.rpc_respond_agreement_change(uuid,boolean)','0bbfc5fd26c97bc5fe953561c2330c49',true,true,'search_path=pg_catalog'),
  ('public.rpc_get_push_device(text)','df3deab04eee429c8bedaf636916791f',true,false,'search_path=pg_catalog'),
  ('public.rpc_set_push_device(text,text,boolean,bigint)','3b97a22d4066a0287d214a56b10d7188',true,false,'search_path=pg_catalog')

select current_timestamp as observed_at,
 (select count(*) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as migration_count,
 (select count(*)=84 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) as migration_count_ok,
 (select count(*)=1 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name='clean_n06_push_device_registry') as stage_history_ok,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name,
   'joined_md5',md5(array_to_string(statements,E'\n')),'joined_bytes',octet_length(array_to_string(statements,E'\n'))) order by version)
   from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name in ('clean_n01_message_event','clean_n02_selection_event','clean_n03_event_inbox','clean_n05_agreement_change_events','clean_n06_push_device_registry')) as actual_live_aliases,
 (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',signature,'exists',oid is not null,
  'source_md5',md5(prosrc),'hash_ok',md5(prosrc)=source_md5,'definer_ok',prosecdef=security_definer,
  'search_path_ok',search_path=any(proconfig),
  'anon_denied',case when oid is null then false else not has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE') end,
  'authenticated_allowed',case when oid is null then false else has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE') end,
  'service_boundary_ok',case when oid is null then false else has_function_privilege('service_role',oid,'EXECUTE')=service_execute end))
   from actual) as functions,
 (select md5(prosrc)='8da91a4736e09b10872bd1240d6e0c8c' from pg_proc
   where oid=to_regprocedure('private.emit_event(uuid,text,text,text,uuid,integer,text,text,text,text,jsonb,timestamptz)')) as emitter_unchanged
